facts.fact: As of March 2025, streaming represents 43.8% of all US television viewing time, according to Nielsen.
facts.quote: As of March 2025, streaming (the content delivered through CTV) represents 43.8% of all US television viewing time, up 10 percentage points in just two years according to Nielsen.

facts.fact: According to Nielsen, streaming's share of US television viewing time rose 10 percentage points over two years.
facts.quote: up 10 percentage points in just two years according to Nielsen

facts.fact: According to Nielsen, 72.4% of US TV viewing time is ad-supported across all platforms.
facts.quote: 72.4% of US TV viewing time is ad-supported on all platforms

facts.fact: According to Nielsen, 42.4% of ad-supported viewing comes from streaming platforms.
facts.quote: 42.4% of ad-supported viewing comes from streaming platforms

facts.fact: According to Nielsen, 56% of global marketers plan to increase CTV spending in 2025, up from 53% in 2024.
facts.quote: 56% of global marketers plan to increase CTV spending in 2025, up from 53% in 2024

facts.fact: According to eMarketer, 87% of US households have at least one CTV device.
facts.quote: 87% of US households have at least one CTV device

facts.fact: According to Nielsen, only 32% of global marketers measure media holistically, covering digital and traditional channels.
facts.quote: Only 32% of global marketers measure media holistically, covering digital and traditional channels

facts.fact: The share of marketers measuring linear and CTV together is 29% in Latin America and 23% in Europe.
facts.quote: This gap is even more pronounced in Latin America (29%) and Europe (23%).

facts.fact: According to MNTN, 57% of viewers prefer CTV ads over traditional linear TV ads.
facts.quote: 57% of viewers prefer CTV ads over traditional linear TV ads

facts.fact: Adwave says platforms like Adwave enable CTV campaigns starting at $50.
facts.quote: Platforms like [Adwave](https://adwave.com/) enable campaigns starting at $50, making television advertising accessible to local businesses and small advertisers.

facts.fact: Linear TV geographic buying operates through Designated Market Areas (DMAs), requiring advertisers to purchase entire markets, while CTV enables targeting at the ZIP code or address level.
facts.quote: Linear TV operates through Designated Market Areas (DMAs), requiring advertisers to purchase entire markets. CTV enables geographic targeting at the ZIP code or even address level

facts.fact: Adults 65+ spend significantly more time with linear television than streaming, per the page.
facts.quote: Adults 65+ spend significantly more time with linear television than streaming.
